title: asi
summary: A Kedro/FastAPI/Streamlit ML pipeline project predicting water potability, with a dedicated synthetic-data pipeline and dashboard tab for generating and evaluating synthetic tabular data. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate synthetic water-quality data and evaluates it with SDV's diagnostic and quality-report metrics.
